description: Defines callback classes and interfaces for cookie store operations, including result handling and thread assertions, used in testing cookie-related functionalities in Chromium.

classes.name: CookieCallback
classes.description: Base class for cookie operation callbacks, managing thread assertions and synchronization.

classes.name: ResultSavingCookieCallback
classes.description: Template class for callbacks that save a result of type T.

classes.name: NoResultCookieCallback
classes.description: Callback class for operations with no result.

classes.name: GetCookieListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving a list of cookies.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesWithAccessSemanticsCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies with access semantics.

methods.name: WaitUntilDone
methods.description: Waits until the callback is invoked.

methods.name: was_run
methods.description: Returns whether the callback was invoked.

methods.name: CallbackEpilogue
methods.description: Performs thread validation and signals completion.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the callback with the result.

methods.name: MakeCallback
methods.description: Creates a bound callback for the operation.
